subject: Unforeseen mechanical field condition: undersized mechanical shaft in the corridor chase

messages.text: Our crew hit the undersized mechanical shaft in the corridor chase at P-101 and need your call on the permanent fix. This needs immediate attention; please respond as soon as possible. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This is not holding up other work currently. Please respond Thursday so we can keep the crew moving.
Reroute to clear the conflict at P-101 per the attached sketch; proceed once you've confirmed clearance. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.
